titles.ja: 干物妹! うまるちゃん

title.ja: うまるとおにいちゃん

1.overview: Responsible Taihei has to deal with his lazy little sister, Umaru, who trashes his apartment and throws tantrums to get manga and junk food.
1.summary:
Umaru reads manga, talks to a hamster, shows off how much of a good girl she is at school, and goes shopping with Onii-chan and stuff!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: うまると海老名ちゃん

2.overview: Taihei comes home to a complete stranger: Umaru’s public face. She’s cleaned the apartment and hidden her games to be able to invite her classmate and neighbor, Ebina, over.
2.summary:
This time... Umaru`s classmate, Ebina-chan comes to visit, Umaru and Onii-chan spend a normal Sunday together, participate in a rock-paper-scissors contest to win a Necolombus, and unexpectedly run into Ebina-chan when they go buy a video game.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: うまると弟子

3.overview: Umaru’s sulky, glaring classmate, Motoba, has unexpectedly shown up at her door… while she’s wearing her hood! Is her secret out?
3.summary:
This time... Umaru takes her midterms, her classmate, Kirie-chan comes by her house and suddenly becomes her student, and Umaru watches a horror movie with Onii-chan!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: うまるとライバル

4.overview: Umaru, aka UMR, is a force to be reckoned with in the arcade. She’s invited to participate in a fighting game championship only to bump into her school rival, Tachibana.
4.summary:
Umaru shows her amazing skills at an arcade, Onii-chan gets a gift from Europe, Umaru plays tennis against Sylphyn, competes in a fighting game tournament, and then for some reason Sylphyn runs off...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: うまると夏休み

5.overview: Summer vacation means hours at the arcade! Umaru instructs in the fine art of enjoying summer like a (lazy) pro. Later, Taihei endures another typical day at work.
5.summary:
This time... As UMR, Umaru plays a game against Sylphyn, and as Komaru, she has Kirie-chan make Calpis, shows the Umaru-style of taking baths, and goes shopping with Ebina-chan and Kirie-chan and all sorts of other things during summer vacation!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: うまるの誕生日

6.overview: Taihei and Umaru experiment with free time and personal space in their little apartment, and playing “The Game of Life” hits too close to home for them all.
6.summary:
Umaru sneaks out to the corner store at night. Onii-chan kills summer break and splits the room in two Kirie-chan and Onii-chan play the Game of Life with Umaru. And then, it`s Umaru-chan`s birthday!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: うまるのお兄ちゃん

7.overview: People in his office have seen Taihei walking home and going shopping with a hot girl! His coworker comes over for a visit to see this so-called “sister” for himself.
7.summary:
This time... Onii-chan throws away some figure parts, Ebina-chan invites Umaru and Onii-chan out to ramen, Umaru eats Japanese candy with Sylphyn, Onii-chan meets a cat and gets confused, unexpectedly invites Bomber to the house, and the shocking truth is revealed... Maybe it was, or maybe it wasn`t...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: うまるとクリスマスと正月
title.en: Umaru and Christmas and New Year`s
title.fr: Umaru et les fêtes de fin d`année

8.overview: In the Doma household, winter means lazy days beneath the kotatsu! Umaru reflects on her interesting year while Taihei tries to collect on a promise she made to him.
8.summary:
This time... Umaru unusually goes out to get the kotatsu out, lazes around the house in the spirit of Christmas, looks back over the year at New Year`s, lazes around the house at New Year`s, goes to the first shrine visit of the year with Onii-chan, and we get to see in the life of Manager Kanau.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: うまるとバレンタイン

9.overview: It’s Valentine’s Day! Kirie burns cookies, Ebina attempts to make chocolate, and Umaru continues to offload food prep to Taihei.
9.summary:
This time... Kirie-chan makes homemade cookies, Ebina-chan makes homemade chocolates, Umaru goes to anumate with Sylphyn, Kirie-chan shows up to the apartment unnannounced, and Umaru has a pudding trial with Onii-chan!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: うまると今と昔々
title.en: Umaru and Now and Once Upon a Time
title.de: Umaru, das Jetzt und die Vergangenheit
title.fr: Umaru, le présent et le passé

10.overview: Umaru gets sick, but it’s a good thing her germs are as lazy as she is! Sadly, her germs show her brother no mercy. Later, Taihei remembers a day at the arcade, 10 years ago.
10.summary:
This time... Umaru catches a cold, then takes care of Onii-chan when he gets a cold, works hard to make Hamburg steak with green peppers in it, gets disconnected from the world and is forced to go to a manga cafe for the first time, and then we get to see a glimpse of Onii-chan`s high school life.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: うまるの日々

11.overview: Umaru and Ebina discover that their appetites match, the council in Umaru’s head furiously debates about the perfect snack, and Taihei tries to get Kirie excited for summer.
11.summary:
This time...　Ebina gives Umaru Akitakomachi rice, eats pizza and parfaits with her, and lots more.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: うまるとみんな

12.overview: In this last episode of the season, Umaru might have to reveal her secret when her separate circles of friends come together during a much anticipated trip to the beach!
12.summary:
This time... Umaru, Onii-chan, Ebina-chan, and Kirie-chan take a road trip to the beach with Bomber in his car.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: おまけ アニメ版 ひもうと! うまるちゃんS

S1.summary:
Umaru welcomes her brother home as if he were coming into a store or restaurant. When he asks why, she says that this is a parallel world. In this world there are three versions of Umaru, one of which is Umaru as she appears in Sankaku Head`s original two-part short manga. Umaru`s duplicates pester Taihei for comics, money, and soda. Taihei remembers that main characters from parallel worlds usually fight until one is left alive, but the Umarus already playing games. He comments that "even in a parallel world, himouto is still himouto".
Source: ANN
